definitions.gloss: nice to meet you, how do you do
definitions.explanation: A greeting used when meeting someone for the first time. Literally means 'for the first time.'

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めまして。{田中|たなか}です。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. I'm Tanaka.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めまして。どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. Please treat me favorably.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めまして。{山田|やまだ}と{申|もう}します。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. My name is Yamada.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めまして。{私|わたし}は{会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いています。よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. I work at a company. Nice to meet you.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めまして。{隣|となり}に{来|き}た{鈴木|すずき}です。これからよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. I'm Suzuki, I just came next door. I look forward to getting to know you.

notes:
{初|はじ}めまして is the standard greeting when meeting someone for the first time. Derived from {初|はじ}めて (for the first time), it literally means 'it is the first time (we meet).'

TYPICAL INTRODUCTION PATTERN:
1. {初|はじ}めまして。(Nice to meet you.)
2. [Name]です / [Name]と{申|もう}します。(I'm [Name]. / My name is [Name] — humble)
3. どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。(Please treat me favorably.)

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- Casual: {初|はじ}めまして。[Name]です。よろしく。
- Standard: {初|はじ}めまして。[Name]です。よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
- Formal: {初|はじ}めまして。[Name]と{申|もう}します。どうぞよろしくお{願|ねが}いいたします。

IMPORTANT:
Only use {初|はじ}めまして on a genuine first meeting. Using it with someone you have met before is awkward and may come across as rude, implying you don't remember them.
